name: TextType-TS-TW
title: TextType
blurb: Text types out character by character, pauses, then deletes and repeats with a…
description: Animates text typing and deleting in a loop through multiple text options. Supports a blinking cursor, variable colors per text, random typing speed, and reverse typing mode. Can trigger on scroll visibility.
use_when: An engaging hero heading wants to cycle through multiple value propositions with typewriter effect.
avoid_when: When content must be immediately readable or when the typing animation would distract from comprehension.
a11y: Text builds character-by-character dynamically; screen readers see the final result after typing completes.
